title: Live Document Phase 0 Scope
description: Phase 0 receives only a concept string. It either keeps the concept, narrows it to a short causal explanation, or marks it unsuitable for a short program-driven animation.

source_concept.description: The original concept exactly as received.

scoped_concept.description: The exact concept boundary passed to Phase 1. For as_is, it preserves the original scope; for narrowed, it states the selected sub-process.

learning_goal.description: What the viewer should understand after watching, without describing implementation or camera design.

duration_seconds.description: Selected duration for the scoped concept. Prefer about 10 seconds and narrow the scope rather than exceed 12 seconds.

causal_chain.description: A short ordered chain of scientific or conceptual causes and effects, not shots or implementation steps.

excluded_content.description: Related material intentionally excluded from this short animation.

misconceptions_to_avoid.description: Incorrect interpretations that later phases must not introduce.

source_concept.description: The original concept exactly as received.

unsuitability_reason.description: Why the concept cannot be responsibly reduced to a short program-driven explanatory animation.
